title: Grateful Dead Live at McDonough Arena - Georgetown University on 1970-10-23
lineage: MC > C > DAT > ??? > CD > EAC > shn
source: Sony TC124 with a 1 point stereo mic 15 feet back from stage

ai_review.summary: Warm audience recording with slight muddiness captures a vibrant 1970 performance where Jerry’s incendiary guitar shines.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers agree the show is a gem from 1970, praising the band’s energy and especially Jerry Garcia’s “incendiary transparent sequences.”  The audio is an audience tape – described as warm and up‑close but with some echo‑laden muddiness – yet it remains listenable on decent speakers.  Overall the performance is highly recommended despite minor sonic imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (70% weight) combined with generally good but not pristine audience recording quality (30% weight) yields a high rating; three reviews provide consistent feedback.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm and up‑close feel, but some listeners note muddiness and an echo‑laden auditorium sound that can soften clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific set‑list commentary; reviewers describe the overall vibe as solid and engaging, with the band in fine form throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for incendiary, transparent guitar sequences that energize the performance.
